tools.name: get_product
tools.description: What PolarJay does and does not do, the five AI assistants it asks (ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Claude and Google AI Overviews), the languages it measures in, who it is for and the company behind it (POLARGATE S.L., Madrid).

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Published plans excluding tax (USD in English, EUR in Spanish, the same number), the queries each includes, the free trial, top-ups, the done-for-you service and the free scanner, with the pricing page URL.

tools.name: list_faq
tools.description: The questions and answers published on the PolarJay FAQ page. Optionally filtered by words in the question or the answer.

tools.name: get_page
tools.description: The full text of one page of polarjay.com as Markdown. Give its path, for example /precios, /en/pricing or /en/how-it-works. Only pages of polarjay.com.

tools.name: how_to_start
tools.description: The two ways to start: the free scanner (no sign-up) and the free trial (no card), with their URLs, plus the contact address.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
